verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official, hosted remote MCP server, the Embedded Dev Assistant, at https://embedded-payroll.readme.io/mcp. It lets agent tools such as Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and its documentation, and the llms.txt index links to its setup guide. Missing for 10: the server is labeled Beta, its scope is limited to Embedded Payroll developer use rather than general Gusto account actions, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Embedded Dev Assistant Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI-powered code editors like Cursor and Windsurf, as well as general-purpose tools like Claude Desktop, to interact directly with the Embedded Payroll API and relevant documentation.
Learn how to set up and test the Gusto Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server for AI-powered tools.
